followup.reason: The labelled defect is a pure in-process logic bug with no network/wire dependency: ossl_quic_get_peer_token() passes the return of ossl_quic_build_new_token(peer, NULL, 0) straight into lh_QUIC_TOKEN_retrieve() without a NULL check. build_new_token() returns NULL whenever BIO_ADDR_rawaddress() fails, which happens for any BIO_ADDR whose address family is not AF_INET/AF_INET6/AF_UNIX -- concretely, a freshly allocated BIO_ADDR_new() (family AF_UNSPEC), exactly the state of a QUIC channel's peer address before the handshake has progressed far enough to learn it, as the ground truth's root_cause states. I confirmed this precondition by reading crypto/bio/bio_addr.c directly rather than assuming it.
